name: lib/fallback-chain
title: Fallback chain
summary: Try stages in order and serve the first that works, saying whether the answer is degraded.

operations.description: The first working stage, its index and whether it is degraded.

invariants.text: Only a stage after the first is degraded.
A total failure carries counts, never error text.
No stages is a failure of zero stages.

gaps: No TypeScript or Python build yet (mzizi-registry#472, phases 1 and 2): until they exist this contract is held by the Rust crate only.
